# Retail CoD 1.1d dedicated server: a blocked brush model mover and a client whose cmds miss frames.
# map mp_carentan, gametype dm (served as probe_crush), one client joined allies, 2026-10-17.
# Two shells, the gsc probe first, then the client about 6 s later:
#   COD_LNXDED_HOME=<absolute, no '+'> PORT=32321 SECS=45 \
#       tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_crush mp_carentan
#   VCOD_NETSIM="ping=40,jitter=70" cargo run -p vcod -- --net-probe 127.0.0.1:32321 \
#       --probe-ride --probe-team allies --probe-secs 34
# probe_crush.gsc lowers model *5's slab (entity 177) onto the standing player and holds
# it there 8 s, then teleports him away and sends the slab home with a moveto in the same
# frame. The PROBE lines are the server half, one per frame of a phase. The rest is the
# client half from --probe-ride, from lift to done: a RIDE line per snapshot received (the
# jittered link drops some) and a line per trajectory change of entity 177. A snapshot
# whose ct equals the one before it ran a frame with no cmd from the player.
# docs/research/cod11-movers.md 12, "A blocked mover", is what it measured.
